WITH m0 AS (
    SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AS month_start,
           DATEADD(month, -12, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)) AS last_12_month_start,
           DATEADD(month, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)) AS next_month_start
)
SELECT TOP 100 YEAR(o.BUDAT) AS year, MONTH(o.BUDAT) AS month, SUM(CAST(o.ZMASAK AS decimal(18,2))) AS ripe_bunches
FROM OPH o
CROSS JOIN m0
JOIN EST e ON e.WERKS = o.WERKS
WHERE o.WERKS = '00EC'
  AND o.BUDAT >= m0.last_12_month_start
  AND o.BUDAT < m0.month_start
  AND e.WERKS IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY YEAR(o.BUDAT), MONTH(o.BUDAT)
ORDER BY year, month

-- Tonnes to the mill
SELECT TOP 100 e.NAME1 AS estate, YEAR(t.d) AS year, MONTH(t.d) AS month, SUM(t.w) / 1000.0 AS tonnes
FROM (SELECT ESTNR, SPB, MIN(BUDAT) AS d, MAX(WB_QTY_TOTAL) AS w FROM FDN WHERE ESTNR = 'EC' AND BUDAT >= DATEADD(month, -12, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)) AND BUDAT < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) GROUP BY ESTNR, SPB) t
JOIN EST e ON e.ESTNR = t.ESTNR AND e.KDATE = '9999-12-31'
WHERE t.w > 0
GROUP BY e.NAME1, YEAR(t.d), MONTH(t.d)
ORDER BY estate, year, month

-- Bunches per mature ha
WITH m0 AS (
    SELECT DATEADD(month, -12, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)) AS twelve_months_ago,
           DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AS this_month
)
SELECT e.NAME1 AS estate, YEAR(o.BUDAT) AS year, MONTH(o.BUDAT) AS month,
       SUM(CAST(o.ZMASAK AS decimal(18,2))) AS ripe_bunches,
       SUM(b.BHA) AS mature_area_ha,
       SUM(CAST(o.ZMASAK AS decimal(18,2))) / NULLIF(SUM(b.BHA), 0) AS ripe_bunches_per_ha
FROM OPH o
JOIN BLK b ON b.ESTNR = RIGHT(o.WERKS, 2) AND b.BLOCK = o.BLOCK AND b.KDATE = '9999-12-31'
JOIN EST e ON e.WERKS = o.WERKS AND e.KDATE = '9999-12-31'
CROSS JOIN m0
WHERE o.WERKS = '00EC' AND o.BUDAT >= m0.twelve_months_ago AND o.BUDAT < m0.this_month
  AND b.BSTATE = 'MATURE'
GROUP BY e.NAME1, YEAR(o.BUDAT), MONTH(o.BUDAT)
ORDER BY year, month

-- Bunches per harvester-day
WITH m AS (
    SELECT DATEADD(month, -12, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)) AS start,
           DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AS end
)
SELECT e.NAME1 AS estate, YEAR(o.BUDAT) AS year, MONTH(o.BUDAT) AS month,
       AVG(d.bunches) AS bunches_per_harvester_day
FROM (
    SELECT WERKS, EMPNR, BUDAT, SUM(CAST(ZMASAK AS decimal(18,2))) AS bunches
    FROM OPH
    WHERE WERKS = '00EC' AND BUDAT >= (SELECT start FROM m) AND BUDAT < (SELECT end FROM m)
    GROUP BY WERKS, EMPNR, BUDAT
) d
JOIN EST e ON e.WERKS = d.WERKS AND e.KDATE = '9999-12-31'
WHERE e.WERKS = '00EC'
GROUP BY e.NAME1, YEAR(o.BUDAT), MONTH(o.BUDAT)
ORDER BY estate, year, month
